messages:
sam: Heads-up — after the calibration tweak on branch "quant/cali-heuristic" we see ~18% p95 regression on FP8 paths for 8k tokens in mixed-precision config. Anyone else?
olga: saw similar on nightly. p50 fine, p95 up. suspect kernel selection switching to fallback INT8 kernel at longer seqs.
tarun: can you paste the perf numbers and the profiler snippet? Did you exclude embedding/lm_head from quant?
sam: yes, embedding+lmh excluded via per-layer mask. Here's perf:
```
config: fp8-mixed, per_layer_mask: embed,lm_head excluded
batch=1 seq=2048 tokens
before: p95=62ms throughput=360 tok/s
after: p95=74ms throughput=300 tok/s
cpu thread: kernel_dispatch: fp8_kern_sel -> fallback_int8 (costly memcpy)
```
kevin: adding microprof:
```
--profile--
kernel_fp8_launch 10us
kernel_int8_launch 4us
copy_kv_cache 820us
kv_lookup 9us
```
olga: copy_kv_cache is the culprit. Where's memcpy happening? maybe because kernel expects contiguous QKV layout after per-layer quant mask.
tarun: that rings true. We added "calibration padding" to force aligned quant blocks; it can introduce an extra re-layout step. I can revert and test.
sam: also noted that for some heads layers (layer 10..12) accuracy dropped when quantized — we had calibrated them but maybe calibration set biases high causing extra branching in kernel which slows it.
maria: product note — some customers reported tail latency spikes yesterday; can we link to incident and notify SRE?
ci-bot: deploy #deploy/quant-cali rolled at 2026-08-01T15:12Z by tarun. Rollout: canary 100%.
kevin: quick experiment: disabled calibration padding and forced kernel_selector to prefer fp8 direct kernels when per_layer_mask present. p95 went down to 65ms. But quality diffs small (delta bleu 0.2).
sam: next steps: 1) tarun to run ablation disabling padding; 2) olga to add metric to kernel_selector to penalize re-layout cost; 3) kevin to run perf/regression harness across seq len distribution.
olga: will add a small opt to return kernel_candidate if layout mismatch implies memcpy>threshold. Also add telemetry tag "rlayout_missed".
tarun: running ablation now. sharing results in ~30m.
sam: thanks. If ablation fixes, we should patch canary and hold until further QA.
